children: Caitlin Donovan, global head of sales at JOOPITER, said sports memorabilia is one of the fastest-growing parts of the collectibles market, according to Bloomberg.

JOOPITER, the digital auction house founded by Pharrell Williams in 2022, has put a game-worn Michael Jordan jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals up for auction with an opening bid of $10 million.

title: JOOPITER Lists Michael Jordan 1998 Finals Jersey With $10 Million Opening Bid
